citations.claim: Before violation, light body centre is left of thin wall (wall x=10..10.1)
At first violating step the centre has jumped to the far side of the wall, proving it crossed through the wall box between steps

explanation: Heavy (m=20, 60 m/s) strikes light body (m=0.2) near a 0.1-thick wall. The collision slingshots the light body to ~535 m/s (energy-conserving given 100:1 mass ratio). At dt=1/30 with 67 substeps the substep displacement (~0.27) exceeds the wall thickness (0.1), so discrete impulse/positional collision handling misses the wall and the centre jumps from x~9.54 (left of wall 10..10.1) to x~17.67 (right of wall) in one step, after also interacting with the right boundary.

violation.detail: body centre moved through wall 0 between steps 800 and 801

vision_note: In steps 798-800 the small red body sits left of the thin vertical wall and closes toward it alongside the larger blue body. In step 801 both bodies are suddenly on the right side of the wall, with the red body teleported far to the right.
